summary.text: Matt Huffman is a Republican who has represented Ohio House District 78 since January 1, 2025, and is Speaker of the House; he is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A Lima attorney, he previously served in the Ohio House from 2007 to 2014 and as Ohio Senate president.

paragraphs.text: Huffman earned a B.A. in government from the University of Notre Dame and a J.D. from the University of Cincinnati School of Law, and he has worked as an attorney and partner at the law firm Huffman, Kelley, and Brock.
He began in politics in 1992 on the Lima City Council, serving as council president from 1998 to 2006.
Huffman entered the Ohio House in 2006 by defeating Dennis Shreefer (D) and was re-elected in 2008, 2010 and 2012, serving as Speaker Pro Tempore from 2012 to 2014.
He was elected to Ohio Senate District 12 in 2016, was elected Senate president in 2020, and left the Senate in 2024 because of term limits.
He returned to the House as a member from District 78 and was selected speaker effective January 6, 2025; Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Rules and Reference Committee for 2025-2026.
In his 2026 campaign, Huffman said, "I have fought for lower taxes, a more efficient government, and innovative ideas to the problems we face."
Jeffrey R. Givan is the Democratic candidate in the 2026 general election.
